title: 恐竜の図鑑風イラスト
lead: ティラノサウルス・トリケラトプス・ステゴサウルスなど、恐竜を図鑑風のタッチで描いた素材12点です。理科の資料や展示の案内に使えます。
subject_en: Realistic natural-history illustration style, each ONE dinosaur full body, side or three-quarter view, centred, scientifically plausible proportions, natural earthy colours, soft shading. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a Tyrannosaurus rex standing with jaws closed
a Triceratops with three horns and a large frill
a Stegosaurus with back plates and tail spikes
a Brachiosaurus with a long neck raised
a feathered Velociraptor in a running pose
an Ankylosaurus with armour plates and a tail club
a Spinosaurus with a tall sail on its back
a Pteranodon gliding with wings spread
a Parasaurolophus with a long head crest
an Allosaurus in a walking pose
a woolly mammoth with long curved tusks
